import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String buffer = scanner.nextLine();
        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();

        int len = buffer.length();
        int i = 0;
        while (i < len) {
            if (buffer.charAt(i) == 'a' && i + 1 < len && buffer.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
                output.append('@');
                i += 2;
            } else if (buffer.charAt(i) == 'd' && i + 2 < len && buffer.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && buffer.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                output.append('.');
                i += 3;
            } else {
                output.append(buffer.charAt(i));
                i++;
            }
        }

        String outStr = output.toString();

        if (outStr.startsWith("@")) {
            System.out.print("at");
        } else if (outStr.startsWith(".")) {
            System.out.print("dot");
        } else {
            System.out.print(outStr.charAt(0));
        }

        boolean atFlag = true;
        for (int j = 1; j < outStr.length(); j++) {
            char ch = outStr.charAt(j);
            if (ch == '@') {
                if (atFlag && j != outStr.length() - 1) {
                    System.out.print("@");
                    atFlag = false;
                } else {
                    System.out.print("at");
                }
            } else if (ch == '.') {
                if (j != outStr.length() - 1) {
                    System.out.print(".");
                } else {
                    System.out.print("dot");
                }
            } else {
                System.out.print(ch);
            }
        }
        System.out.println();
        scanner.close();
    }
}
